videos.title: Join the testers
videos.shows: Open the tester invite, become a tester and find the app on Google Play.

videos.title: Install from Google Play
videos.shows: Install or update from Google Play, and move over safely from the old download-link app.

videos.title: Sign in
videos.shows: Sign in with Continue with Google and join your company's workspace.

videos.title: First steps
videos.shows: Allow the permissions, set up the phone for calls and alerts, and pick a theme.

videos.title: If something hangs
videos.shows: Never reinstall: tap Reload, or Refresh app data in Phone & alerts.

videos.title: Call a lead and log how it went
videos.shows: Call in one tap, then log how the call went and what happens next.

videos.title: Lead stages and the Board
videos.shows: The nine lead stages, the Board, moving a lead and the pipeline numbers.

videos.title: My work and notes
videos.shows: Everything you did today, yesterday or this week, and quick notes on a lead.

videos.title: All leads: filter and sort
videos.shows: Search, filter and sort your whole lead list, and save the views you use.

videos.title: Never lose a change
videos.shows: What Not sent yet and All changes saved mean, and why your work is safe.

videos.title: Tasks and reminders
videos.shows: Your follow-ups by Overdue, Today and Upcoming, and Remind on any lead.
